createdAt.description: Timestamp of record creation in the ATProto PDS.

occurrenceID.description: The occurrenceID of the linked occurrence record (for cross-system interoperability).

measurementID.description: An identifier for the measurement. Should be unique within the dataset.

occurrenceRef.description: AT-URI reference to the app.gainforest.dwc.occurrence record this measurement belongs to.

measurementType.description: The nature of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion (e.g., 'DBH', 'tree height', 'canopy cover', 'tail length', 'body mass', 'soil pH', 'water temperature').

measurementUnit.description: The units for the measurementValue (e.g., 'cm', 'm', 'kg', 'mm', '%', 'degrees Celsius').

measurementValue.description: The value of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion (e.g., '45.2', 'present', 'blue').

measurementMethod.description: The description of or reference to the method used to determine the measurement (e.g., 'diameter tape at 1.3m height', 'laser rangefinder', 'Bitterlich method').

measurementRemarks.description: Comments or notes accompanying the measurement.

measurementAccuracy.description: The description of the potential error associated with the measurementValue (e.g., '0.5 cm', '5%').

measurementDeterminedBy.description: Person(s) who determined the measurement. Pipe-delimited for multiple.

measurementDeterminedDate.description: The date the measurement was made. ISO 8601 format.

main.description: A measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion about an occurrence. Multiple measurement records can reference the same occurrence, solving the Simple DwC one-measurement-per-record limitation.

schema.description: A measurement or fact record aligned with the Darwin Core MeasurementOrFact class. Extension record that links to an occurrence, enabling multiple measurements per organism (e.g., DBH, height, canopy cover for a tree).
